nodes.label: Initramfs Setuid Support
nodes.rationale: Set the S_ISUID bit on the initramfs inode so an execve of the file by an unprivileged user elevates the new task's euid to the file's owner (uid 0 — initramfs files are root-owned). Used for /bin/su.

nodes.label: M41 16 GiB firmware-map memory smoke
nodes.rationale: On-demand check that the x86_64 kernel sees >=15000 MiB usable from a 16G QEMU machine by grepping the 'pmm: firmware RAM' serial line — proves DIRECT_MAP_MAX large-RAM support.

nodes.label: POSIX shell/coreutils in-guest smoke (M11/M22-POLISH)
nodes.rationale: Runs INSIDE the guest under /bin/sh; each test emits a deterministic 'M11-SHELL: ok ...' marker that the host-side smoke.sh greps from the serial log. Ordered simple-to-complex so failures isolate easily.

nodes.label: M39 serial getty/login end-to-end test
nodes.rationale: Boots NORMAL mode (no b1nix.test, so the inittab supervisor runs), drives QEMU serial stdio with python3 as a real terminal: login as root, verify interactive bash via a guest-computed SERIAL-E2E-42 probe, exit, and confirm init respawns getty. Separate from smoke.sh because the supervisor never starts in test mode.

nodes.label: M32c external SSH hostfwd smoke
nodes.rationale: Separate from smoke.sh so CI never exposes a forwarded port by accident. The login marker EXTSSH-42-OK is computed ON the guest ($((6*7))) so it can never match the literal command echoed by expect — proving the remote shell actually ran. nc banner probe holds the connection open so a half-close doesn't abort the server's ident exchange.
